name: The Super Snapper FX
summary: Curgle Cranklehop has a new picture-taking device ready, the Super Snapper FX, and hands it to you to try out. The subject is Gammerita, a creature from the Hinterlands. With her snapshot in hand, you bring it and the device to Daryn Lightwind in Rut'theran Village. This follows The Borrower.

sections.title: A Device to Test
sections.body: After The Borrower, Curgle Cranklehop presents you with the Super Snapper FX, a new invention of theirs. Using it is simple: aim at whatever you want pictured and press the button. Curgle gives it to you to try out.

sections.title: The Subject
sections.body: The subject is Gammerita, a creature from the Hinterlands that you had mentioned to Curgle. Curgle wishes you luck in finding her, and expects Daryn Lightwind to be pleased with the snapshot. Once you have it, the picture and the device go to Daryn in Rut'theran Village.

faq.q: Who gives the Super Snapper FX?
aliases: where to get super snapper fx
faq.answer: Curgle Cranklehop hands you the device, a new invention, for you to try out.

faq.q: What do I photograph with the Super Snapper FX?
faq.answer: Gammerita, a creature from the Hinterlands. Curgle wishes you luck finding her.
Daryn Lightwind in Rut'theran Village. You bring her both the snapshot and the device.

faq.q: What comes next in the chain?
faq.answer: The chain goes on with Return to Troyas.
